Live walkthrough · Apache JMeter

Feather Wand 4.0.0

The AI assistant inside Apache JMeter. Four releases, one goal: spend less time fighting the tool and more time finding bottlenecks.

What today

v1 → v4 tour, real features, live demo, and the numbers behind adoption.

Where

Plugins Manager in JMeter 5.6.3+, or drop the jar in lib/ext.

The pitch

An AI teammate that lives inside JMeter

  • Not a chatbot in a browser tab. It sees your test plan tree, your samplers, your results.
  • Chat, agent, or terminal. Ask questions, let it edit the plan, or drive Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode right in JMeter.
  • Designs real workloads. Samples-per-second targets in, ${"{"}__P(){"}"}-ready thread groups and CLI commands out.
  • Your keys, your models. 9 cloud providers, local Ollama, or your CLI subscriptions. No middleman.
The journey

Four majors in eighteen months

v1
Apr 2025
AI chat inside JMeter. Ask about your plan, @commands, extractors.
v2
Feb 2026
AI CLI terminal. Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode: your subscriptions, no API key.
v3
Jul 2026
Agent Mode. The AI edits your test plan through 21 tools. Make it pass.
v4

Workload design. Rates in, thread groups out. No AI call needed.

Each release moved the AI one step closer to the work: talk → type → act → design.

v1.0 · April 2025

Chat that knows your test plan

  • Context-aware chat: answers about your plan, not generic JMeter docs.
  • @commands: @this, @testplan, @lint, @optimize, @wrap, @code.
  • Extract this: right-click a value in View Results Tree, get a working correlator. No API key needed.
  • Streaming + Stop, saved sessions, conversation export to Markdown/HTML.
v1 · the chat panel
Feather Wand 4.0.0 welcome state: the chat panel is a split view next to your plan.
v2.0 · February 2026

Your AI CLIs, inside JMeter

  • Real terminal, real CLIs: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode, Antigravity, Grok CLI.
  • Subscription auth: use the plan you already pay for; no API key juggling.
  • JMeter context on demand: the CLI can read your plan, your jmeter.log, your results.
  • CJK-ready rendering, configurable fonts, sandboxed defaults.
v2 · AI CLI terminal
Claude Code v2.1.325 running in Feather Wand's embedded terminal, taken today on this machine.
v3.0 · July 2026

Agent Mode: it stops advising and starts doing

  • 21 tools: read the tree, add/move/update elements, set properties, record, run.
  • Visible work: every tool call shows in an expandable activity trace. Nothing hidden.
  • Destructive = confirmed: delete, move, open-plan and correlation changes ask first.
  • Make it pass: runs your plan, repairs what fails, verifies with a real JMeter run.
  • MCP server: Feather Wand itself becomes a tool server for your IDE agent.
v3 · agent at work
"add a debug sampler named heartbeat": the agent read the tree, then edited it. 6 tool calls, all inspectable.
v3 · the result lands in the tree
The heartbeat DebugSampler, added by the agent, sitting in Jakarta Users. Real plan, real edit.
v4.0 · November 2026, today's release

Describe the load. Get the plan.

  • Workload Designer: target samples/sec, duration, generators → threads, pacing, ${"{"}__P(){"}"} properties.
  • Six load shapes: Load, Endurance, Step, Spike, Stress, Custom.
  • Workload Preflight: checks enabled elements and inherited settings before you burn a run.
  • Copy-paste CLI: Bash, cmd, PowerShell variants ready for CI.
  • Plan-aware starters: the empty chat now suggests what to do with this plan.
  • Zero AI required: deterministic math; Ask AI is an optional second opinion.
v4 · Workload Designer
50 samples/s against Jakarta Users: typed fields, sane bounds, "Ready to apply".
v4 · see the shape before you run it
38 threads ramping to a 10-minute hold at 50 samples/s, previewed before a single request fires.
v4 · preflight, then ship the command
Preflight: no findings. Out comes jmeter -n -t SimpleTestPlan.jmx -Jload.threads=38 …, straight into CI.
v4 · plan-aware starters
Open a plan, get suggestions that fit it: "Add a CSV data set", "Review this Thread Group", "Plan the workload".
Bring your own model

One picker. Every provider.

  • Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, Ollama, Grok, OpenRouter, Meta Muse, Bedrock, plus CLI accounts.
  • Searchable picker: context size, cost per Mtok, vision, thinking, favorites, recents.
  • Thinking + effort controls, live context & cost readout.
muse-spark-1.1: 1M ctx, $1.25/$4.25 per Mtok, vision, thinking.
Why it matters

Where the hours go, and where they come back

min
Correlation used to mean regex trial-and-error. "Extract this" proposes verified extractors in seconds.
0
Context switches. Chat, CLI, plan edits, workload math. None of it leaves the JMeter window.
1
Click from "50 samples/s for 10 min" to a CI-ready command. No spreadsheet math, no property typos.
✓
Preflight + Make it pass catch broken plans before the expensive run, not after.

The tool does the remembering; you do the thinking.
